title: Natural Anti-Inflammatory Elixir
description: A powerful natural anti-inflammatory blend to help with arthritis, pain, and neurodegenerative diseases. This elixir is made with honey, turmeric, black pepper, and ginger.
steps: Take a tablespoon of this once a day on an empty stomach.
If you can't handle it by itself, you could put it into a glass of milk, warm or cold.
notes:
The author mentions that local honey is preferred and that the wood used for honey might matter. Black pepper is said to activate the turmeric. The elixir is fragrant and smells like it can 'kill anything bad in you'. It is described as tasting delicious, not like medicine, and can be consumed like coffee. There are claims that some ingredients may shrink tumor cells, and it is good for inflammation, intestines, and stomach. The author is not a doctor and is repeating claims. Doctors are encouraged to comment on its efficacy.

Source: https://www.facebook.com/share/v/1DE7AwtLRt/
